Build a wilder world - Planet Zoo 2 is available now!
 
Create and manage distinctive zoos around the world filled with awe-inspiring animals, including fully aquatic and flying species, before venturing beyond the zoo to release your animals into expansive new Wildlife Reserves. 
 
Soar to great heights with flying birds, prepare your diving suits as fully-aquatic species make a splash, and take your conservation efforts beyond your zoo in brand-new Wildlife Reserves!
